designAdjustments: Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Increased PRT-01 (Universal iPhone Camera Alignment Saddle) structural perimeter wall to 3.2mm (4 walls) with 2.0mm root fillets.
Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Widened mating sliding/fastener clearance on PRT-02 (Threaded 100× Achromatic Doublet Lens Barrel) from 0.08mm to 0.25mm with 45° lead-in chamfers.

rounds.summary: Round 1 DFM audit flagged 2 printability improvements on PRT-01 and PRT-02; looping back to Designer.

issues.part: PRT-01 · Universal iPhone Camera Alignment Saddle
issues.problem: Initial 1.6mm wall thickness around primary clamping boss shows localized deflection under load.
issues.finding: Initial 1.6mm wall thickness around primary clamping boss shows localized deflection under load.
issues.fix: Increase wall thickness to 3.2mm (4 perimeters) and add 2.0mm gusset fillets.
issues.fixApplied: Increased wall thickness to 3.2mm and added 2.0mm gusset fillets.

issues.part: PRT-02 · Threaded 100× Achromatic Doublet Lens Barrel
issues.problem: Nominal 0.08mm sliding/thread clearance may bind due to FDM seam ridge.
issues.finding: Nominal 0.08mm sliding/thread clearance may bind due to FDM seam ridge.
issues.fix: Widen radial clearance to 0.25mm and add 1.0mm × 45° entry chamfer.
issues.fixApplied: Widened clearance to 0.25mm with 45° entry chamfer.

rounds.summary: Round 2 DFM verification PASSED (97/100): all 4 printed parts fit Bambu Lab A1 (256×256×256mm) with zero supports.
fixesApplied: Verified all 4 printed parts pass overhangs <=42°, walls >=2.4mm, tolerances >=0.25mm & bed fit.
